split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Accuracy 0.847 only because it answers 'no diabetes' for everyone: recall 0, F1 0, ROC-AUC 0.50. Shows that accuracy is misleading on this data.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Class-weighted linear model: ROC-AUC 0.815, recall 0.77 but precision only 0.32. Trains in 0.4 s. A strong, cheap reference point.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Unlimited-depth forest: ROC-AUC 0.779 and recall only 0.16 at the 0.5 cut-off. AUC rose from 0.735 (10 trees) to 0.776 (100) and 0.779 (200), so more trees help little. Tuning (T07) fixed most of the gap with shallower trees.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Default boosting is already the best untuned model: ROC-AUC 0.820, PR-AUC 0.445, in 2.6 s.

features: 25 features (21 original + 4 engineered), trained on 20,000-row sample
split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: SVM trained on 20,000 rows (about 12% of the training set): ROC-AUC 0.800. Not a fair comparison with the full-data models, and the cost of the SVM grows quickly with more rows.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Tuning changed nothing: C from 0.01 to 10 and class weighting gave CV ROC-AUC between 0.8084 and 0.8086. The limit comes from the linear form of the model, not from the regularisation.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Best settings: max_depth 12, min_samples_leaf 50, max_features 0.5. ROC-AUC rose from 0.779 (T03) to 0.817 and F1 0.460 is the highest F1 of all runs. Shallower, smoother trees reduced the overfitting of T03.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Best traditional model: learning_rate 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 15, min_samples_leaf 20, l2 10. ROC-AUC 0.8199, PR-AUC 0.4457. Gain over the default T04 is only 0.0002 in AUC, so tuning barely mattered.

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Same model without the 4 engineered features: ROC-AUC 0.8195 vs 0.8199 and PR-AUC 0.4455 vs 0.4457. No measurable benefit from the new features on this split (run-to-run variation was not measured).

split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: Without class weights the ranking quality is the same (ROC-AUC 0.8200), but recall falls from 0.79 to 0.17 while precision rises from 0.32 to 0.58 and accuracy to 0.855. Class weights change the balance of errors at the 0.5 cut-off, not how well people are ranked.

features: 25 features (21 original + 4 engineered), SMOTE on train
split: stratified 70/15/15, seed 42, duplicates removed (train 160,631 / val 34,421 / test 34,422)
observations: SMOTE (training set only): ROC-AUC 0.818, recall 0.25, precision 0.54. It moves the balance of errors less than class weights and the AUC is slightly lower than T08.
